decisions.reason: The burner component is built into the firm's core radiant heater line, so the investment is embedded and there is little reason to withdraw it.
The electric infrared panel heater has its own web page and fits the announced move toward electrified, lower-carbon heating, so management is publicly committed to it and will keep it.
Halogen infrared is a more peripheral technology, but it is visibly presented and extends the established offer, so any weak early results will be put down to the market ramp-up.
The industrial electric hall heater is close to the core business, presented on its own page and serves the firm's main customers, so commitment to it is strong.

The hydrogen-capable heater is central to the announced strategic direction and was publicly showcased in a real operating installation, so escalation pressure and its strategic role make withdrawal very unlikely.
